lead: Competitive intelligence captures show vendor activity focused on EFB platform deployments, digital flight planning enhancements, and integration of AI and cloud capabilities across major aviation software providers.

insights.title: IFS Secures Multiple LCC and Regional Airline EFB Wins
insights.finding: IFS captured multiple customer wins for its IFS EFBOne platform, including selections by fastjet and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air).
insights.aviation_context: fastjet is an African low-cost carrier (LCC), and MY FREIGHTER / Centrum Air is classified as an LCC.
insights.caveat: Captured text indicates these represent specific fleet adoptions rather than enterprise-wide standardizations across all group entities.

insights.title: Aviobook Signs Long-Term Agreement with Royal Air Maroc
insights.finding: Thales (Aviobook) secured a five-year agreement with Royal Air Maroc to deploy the AvioBook Flight EFB platform.
insights.aviation_context: Royal Air Maroc operates as a network carrier connecting Africa, Europe, and the Americas.
insights.caveat: The agreement is structured as a five-year deployment term.

insights.title: Jeppesen Integrates AI Foundation Models into ForeFlight
insights.finding: Jeppesen integrated Archer's ZEE aviation foundation model into ForeFlight Mobile EFB for real-time on-device ATC transcription.
insights.aviation_context: On-device transcription targets cockpit communication workflows during flight operations.
insights.caveat: This announcement marks the first phase of the integration.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Explores Divestment of Core Units
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems is reportedly exploring a sale of its Lido and NetLine business units for approximately €1bn.
insights.aviation_context: Lido and NetLine cover flight planning, navigation charting, and crew management systems.
insights.caveat: Reported via financial media coverage and subject to change.
